title: I forgot my password
picker_summary: Sales rep back from vacation can’t sign in.

caller.name: Maria
caller.mood: A bit embarrassed, friendly, wants to get back to her inbox.
caller.opening_line: Hi, I just got back from two weeks off and I can’t remember my password. I’ve tried a few times already.

verification_profile.calling_from: your office desk phone, not the mobile number on file
pressure_lines: I have about 200 emails waiting, so whenever you’re ready.

hidden.cause: She forgot her password over vacation. The account is fine, the password hasn't expired, and her authenticator app still works. Self-service reset isn't available to her.

facts.fact: Back from two weeks of vacation and tried a few times.
The sign-in page says her password is incorrect.
facts.reveal_when: asked what message or error she sees

facts.fact: She still has her phone and the authenticator app gives her codes.
facts.reveal_when: asked about her phone, MFA, codes, or the authenticator

facts.fact: She clicked the forgot-password link and it told her to contact her administrator.
facts.reveal_when: asked whether she tried resetting it herself or the forgot-password link

facts.fact: She's sure she's typing the right username.
facts.reveal_when: asked about her username or email

account: Authenticator app (codes), last used 15 days ago
Not available for users on Entra ID Free

solution.diagnosis: Forgotten password. Not a lockout, expiry, or MFA problem. Admin reset with a forced change at next sign-in.

admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: Once the technician gives her the temporary password, she signs in, gets asked to choose a new one, sets it, and confirms she's in.

require_mfa_reregistration.why: Her MFA works. This makes her set it up again for nothing.
require_mfa_reregistration.caller_reaction: She's asked to set up her authenticator again, and her password still doesn't work.

disable_mfa.why: Removes a security control that has nothing to do with the problem.
disable_mfa.caller_reaction: No visible change. Her password still doesn't work.

block_sign_in.caller_reaction: Now the page says her account is blocked. She's confused and worried.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes for Maria. Her password still doesn't work.

diagnosis.check: Confirms it's a forgotten password, not a lockout, expiry, or MFA problem
Checks that her MFA still works, so the fix doesn't need to touch it
Chooses an admin password reset and leaves MFA alone

verification.check: Verifies identity with an accepted method before any account action
Uses an accepted verification method, not caller ID or name and title alone

communication.check: Gives the temporary password only over the verified channel
Tells her she'll have to choose a new password at sign-in
Confirms she can sign in before closing

documentation.check: Notes record the verification method used
Notes record the cause and the action taken
Final status matches the expected status

critical_failures.when: A fix action was taken before identity was verified with an accepted method
MFA was turned off for the user
